title: pkg/util: allow uid and gid options on tmpfs mounts
body:

### Problem

When creating containers via the Docker-compatible API or specifying mount options with explicit ownership on tmpfs mounts (such as `--tmpfs /mnt:rw,size=64m,mode=0700,uid=1000,gid=1000`), Podman rejected the options with:

```
container create: unknown mount option "uid=1000": invalid mount option
```

Docker and standard Linux tmpfs mount syntax support explicit numeric ownership options `uid` and `gid`.

### Solution

- Updated `processOptionsInternal` in `pkg/util/mount_opts.go` to recognize `uid` and `gid` mount options when `isTmpfs` is true.
- Enforced that duplicate `uid` or `gid` specifications are rejected with `ErrDupeMntOption`.
- Enforced that `uid` and `gid` options are disallowed on non-tmpfs mounts with `ErrBadMntOption`.
- Added unit tests in `pkg/util/utils_test.go` covering valid `uid`/`gid` options, duplicate options, and non-tmpfs rejections.

Fixes: #29979
Signed-off-by: sundeep8967 <sundeep8967@gmail.com>

comments.body: Please add an E2E or system test verifying the options are actually passed to the mount and ownership is correctly changed.
